items.question: Trong câu "Bubble, selection and insertion sort are simple, but they compare elements pair by pair, so in the average and worst case they are O(n²).", từ "pair by pair" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bubble, selection and insertion sort are simple, but they compare elements pair by pair, so in the average and worst case they are O(n²).", what does "pair by pair" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: all at once as a group
two at a time, one pair after another
from the end to the start
items.explanation: pair by pair /peər baɪ peər/ (cụm từ): từng cặp một. Mẫu "X by X" diễn tả làm lần lượt: step by step (từng bước), one by one (từng cái một).
items.explanationEn: pair by pair /peər baɪ peər/ (phrase): two at a time, one pair after another. The pattern "X by X" means one unit after another: step by step, one by one.

items.question: Trong câu "That is fine for 50 items and hopeless for 100,000:", từ "hopeless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is fine for 50 items and hopeless for 100,000:", what does "hopeless" (adjective) mean?
options: vô vọng, hoàn toàn không dùng được
optionsEn: with no chance of working well
using quite a lot of memory
items.explanation: hopeless /ˈhəʊp.ləs/ (tính từ): vô vọng, hoàn toàn không dùng được. Thường dùng "hopeless for/at something" để nói một cách làm hoàn toàn không phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: hopeless /ˈhəʊp.ləs/ (adjective): with no chance of working well. Often used as "hopeless for/at something" to say an approach cannot possibly work.

items.question: Trong câu "At roughly 10⁸ simple operations per second, bubble sort on 100,000 items takes about 100 seconds; an O(n log n) sort finishes in milliseconds.", từ "roughly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At roughly 10⁸ simple operations per second, bubble sort on 100,000 items takes about 100 seconds; an O(n log n) sort finishes in milliseconds.", what does "roughly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (trạng từ): khoảng, xấp xỉ. Dùng khi ước lượng con số: roughly 10 ms, roughly half; đồng nghĩa với approximately, about.
items.explanationEn: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (adverb): approximately. Used for estimates: roughly 10 ms, roughly half; a synonym of approximately or about.

items.question: Trong câu "The price is simplicity: they are recursive and take longer to understand.", từ "recursive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The price is simplicity: they are recursive and take longer to understand.", what does "recursive" (adjective) mean?
options: đệ quy (tự gọi lại chính nó)
optionsEn: defined in terms of itself; calling itself
items.explanation: recursive /rɪˈkɜː.sɪv/ (tính từ): đệ quy (tự gọi lại chính nó). Cụm hay gặp: recursive function (hàm đệ quy), recursive call (lời gọi đệ quy).
items.explanationEn: recursive /rɪˈkɜː.sɪv/ (adjective): defined in terms of itself; calling itself. Common collocations: recursive function, recursive call.

items.question: Trong câu "Both algorithms rest on one observation: an array of 0 or 1 elements is already sorted.", từ "observation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both algorithms rest on one observation: an array of 0 or 1 elements is already sorted.", what does "observation" (noun) mean?
options: nhận xét, điều quan sát thấy
items.explanation: observation /ˌɒb.zəˈveɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): nhận xét, điều quan sát thấy. "Rest on an observation" = dựa trên một nhận xét; động từ gốc là observe (quan sát, nhận thấy).
items.explanationEn: observation /ˌɒb.zəˈveɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a fact you notice. "Rest on an observation" means to be based on a noticed fact; the verb is observe.

items.question: Trong câu "That is the base case of the recursion (a reminder from the recursion topic: every recursive function needs a base case and a smaller input on each call).", từ "reminder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is the base case of the recursion (a reminder from the recursion topic: every recursive function needs a base case and a smaller input on each call).", what does "reminder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: something that makes you recall a fact
items.explanation: reminder /rɪˈmaɪn.dər/ (danh từ): lời nhắc lại. "A reminder from/of something" = điều nhắc lại kiến thức đã học; động từ: remind (nhắc nhở).
items.explanationEn: reminder /rɪˈmaɪn.dər/ (noun): something that makes you recall a fact. "A reminder of/from something" recalls what was learned before; the verb is remind.

items.question: Trong câu "Both then apply divide and conquer, but they put the hard work in different places:", từ "divide and conquer" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both then apply divide and conquer, but they put the hard work in different places:", what does "divide and conquer" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: split a problem into parts and solve each
items.explanation: divide and conquer /dɪˌvaɪd ən ˈkɒŋ.kər/ (cụm từ): chia để trị. Tên một chiến lược thuật toán: chia bài toán thành bài toán con, giải rồi gộp kết quả.
items.explanationEn: divide and conquer /dɪˌvaɪd ən ˈkɒŋ.kər/ (phrase): split a problem into parts and solve each. The name of an algorithm strategy: split into subproblems, solve them, then combine.

items.question: Trong câu "A good way to remember it: merge sort splits blindly and merges carefully; quick sort partitions carefully and never merges.", từ "blindly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A good way to remember it: merge sort splits blindly and merges carefully; quick sort partitions carefully and never merges.", what does "blindly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách máy móc, không xem xét
optionsEn: without looking at or thinking about the data
items.explanation: blindly /ˈblaɪnd.li/ (trạng từ): một cách máy móc, không xem xét. Nghĩa đen là "mù quáng"; ở đây merge sort chia đôi mà không cần nhìn giá trị phần tử.
items.explanationEn: blindly /ˈblaɪnd.li/ (adverb): without looking at or thinking about the data. Literally "without sight"; here merge sort splits without looking at the values.

items.question: Trong câu "It must run in O(n + m) time and space and must not modify its inputs.", từ "modify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It must run in O(n + m) time and space and must not modify its inputs.", what does "modify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: modify /ˈmɒd.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): thay đổi, chỉnh sửa. "Modify the input" = sửa dữ liệu đầu vào; trái nghĩa: leave the input untouched.
items.explanationEn: modify /ˈmɒd.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to change. "Modify the input" means changing it; the opposite is leaving the input untouched.

items.question: Trong câu "The idea is the two pointers pattern: look at the smallest unused value in each array, take the smaller one, advance that pointer.", từ "unused" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The idea is the two pointers pattern: look at the smallest unused value in each array, take the smaller one, advance that pointer.", what does "unused" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unused /ʌnˈjuːzd/ (tính từ): chưa được dùng. Tiền tố un- mang nghĩa phủ định: unused, unsorted, untouched.
items.explanationEn: unused /ʌnˈjuːzd/ (adjective): not yet used. The prefix un- negates: unused, unsorted, untouched.

items.question: Trong câu "The idea is the two pointers pattern: look at the smallest unused value in each array, take the smaller one, advance that pointer.", từ "advance" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The idea is the two pointers pattern: look at the smallest unused value in each array, take the smaller one, advance that pointer.", what does "advance" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: advance /ədˈvɑːns/ (động từ): dịch lên, tiến tới. "Advance a pointer/index" = tăng con trỏ lên vị trí kế tiếp; nghĩa khác: ứng trước tiền.
items.explanationEn: advance /ədˈvɑːns/ (verb): to move forward. "Advance a pointer/index" means moving it to the next position; another sense is paying early.

items.question: Trong câu "When one array runs out, copy the rest of the other.", từ "run out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When one array runs out, copy the rest of the other.", what does "run out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: run out /rʌn ˈaʊt/ (cụm từ): hết, cạn. Hay dùng "run out of something": run out of memory (hết bộ nhớ), run out of time.
items.explanationEn: run out /rʌn ˈaʊt/ (phrase): to have nothing left. Often "run out of something": run out of memory, run out of time.

items.question: Trong câu "Forgetting the two "copy the rest" loops is the classic bug — the tail of one array silently disappears.", từ "tail" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forgetting the two "copy the rest" loops is the classic bug — the tail of one array silently disappears.", what does "tail" (noun) mean?
options: phần đuôi, phần còn lại cuối
optionsEn: the last part of a sequence
items.explanation: tail /teɪl/ (danh từ): phần đuôi, phần còn lại cuối. Trong cấu trúc dữ liệu: head (đầu) và tail (đuôi) của mảng hoặc danh sách liên kết.
items.explanationEn: tail /teɪl/ (noun): the last part of a sequence. In data structures: the head and the tail of an array or linked list.

items.question: Trong câu "Forgetting the two "copy the rest" loops is the classic bug — the tail of one array silently disappears.", từ "silently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forgetting the two "copy the rest" loops is the classic bug — the tail of one array silently disappears.", what does "silently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: silently /ˈsaɪ.lənt.li/ (trạng từ): lặng lẽ, không báo lỗi. "Fail silently" = hỏng mà không báo lỗi, loại lỗi khó phát hiện nhất.
items.explanationEn: silently /ˈsaɪ.lənt.li/ (adverb): without any error or warning. "Fail silently" means breaking without any error, the hardest kind of bug to notice.

items.question: Trong câu "With merge in hand, merge sort is short:", từ "in hand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With merge in hand, merge sort is short:", what does "in hand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in hand /ɪn ˈhænd/ (cụm từ): đã có sẵn trong tay. "With X in hand" = khi đã có X để dùng; nghĩa khác "the task in hand" = việc đang làm.
items.explanationEn: in hand /ɪn ˈhænd/ (phrase): already available to use. "With X in hand" means having X ready; "the task in hand" means the current task.

items.question: Trong câu "With only arr.length === 0, a one-element array splits into [] and [x], and mergeSort([x]) calls itself forever until the stack overflows.", từ "overflow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With only arr.length === 0, a one-element array splits into [] and [x], and mergeSort([x]) calls itself forever until the stack overflows.", what does "overflow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overflow /ˌəʊ.vəˈfləʊ/ (động từ): tràn (vượt quá sức chứa). "Stack overflow" = tràn ngăn xếp, xảy ra khi đệ quy không có điểm dừng.
items.explanationEn: overflow /ˌəʊ.vəˈfləʊ/ (verb): to exceed its capacity. "Stack overflow" happens when recursion never reaches a stopping point.

items.question: Trong câu "This version returns a new array and leaves the input untouched (except that a 0- or 1-element input is returned as the same reference).", từ "untouched" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This version returns a new array and leaves the input untouched (except that a 0- or 1-element input is returned as the same reference).", what does "untouched" (adjective) mean?
options: nguyên vẹn, không bị thay đổi
items.explanation: untouched /ʌnˈtʌtʃt/ (tính từ): nguyên vẹn, không bị thay đổi. "Leave something untouched" = để nguyên, không động vào.
items.explanationEn: untouched /ʌnˈtʌtʃt/ (adjective): not changed at all. "Leave something untouched" means not changing it in any way.

items.question: Trong câu "This version returns a new array and leaves the input untouched (except that a 0- or 1-element input is returned as the same reference).", từ "reference" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This version returns a new array and leaves the input untouched (except that a 0- or 1-element input is returned as the same reference).", what does "reference" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a pointer to the same object in memory
items.explanation: reference /ˈref.ər.əns/ (danh từ): tham chiếu (tới đối tượng). "The same reference" = cùng trỏ tới một đối tượng; khác với "a copy" (bản sao).
items.explanationEn: reference /ˈref.ər.əns/ (noun): a pointer to the same object in memory. "The same reference" points to the same object, unlike "a copy".

items.question: Trong câu "Halving n until the pieces have size 1 takes log n levels.", từ "halve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Halving n until the pieces have size 1 takes log n levels.", what does "halve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to divide into two equal parts
items.explanation: halve /hɑːv/ (động từ): chia đôi. Động từ của half; "halve the range" = chia đôi khoảng. Trái nghĩa: double.
items.explanationEn: halve /hɑːv/ (verb): to divide into two equal parts. The verb of half; "halve the range" means cutting it in two. Opposite: double.

items.question: Trong câu "As a recurrence: T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n), which solves to O(n log n).", từ "recurrence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As a recurrence: T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n), which solves to O(n log n).", what does "recurrence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an equation defining a value from smaller values
items.explanation: recurrence /rɪˈkʌr.əns/ (danh từ): hệ thức truy hồi. "Solve a recurrence" = giải hệ thức truy hồi để tìm độ phức tạp; nghĩa thường: sự lặp lại, tái diễn.
items.explanationEn: recurrence /rɪˈkʌr.əns/ (noun): an equation defining a value from smaller values. "Solve a recurrence" to find complexity; in everyday use it means something happening again.

items.question: Trong câu "An already-sorted array is still split and merged in full, so the best case is also O(n log n).", từ "in full" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An already-sorted array is still split and merged in full, so the best case is also O(n log n).", what does "in full" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in full /ɪn ˈfʊl/ (cụm từ): đầy đủ, trọn vẹn. Hay gặp: pay in full (trả đủ), read in full (đọc toàn bộ).
items.explanationEn: in full /ɪn ˈfʊl/ (phrase): completely. Common uses: pay in full, read something in full.

items.question: Trong câu "That predictability is its strength.", từ "predictability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That predictability is its strength.", what does "predictability" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the quality of behaving as expected
items.explanation: predictability /prɪˌdɪk.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính dễ đoán trước. Từ gốc predict (dự đoán) → predictable (dễ đoán) → predictability.
items.explanationEn: predictability /prɪˌdɪk.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): the quality of behaving as expected. Built from predict → predictable → predictability.

items.question: Trong câu "Space O(n): the merge buffers hold up to n elements, and the recursion stack is only O(log n) deep.", từ "buffer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Space O(n): the merge buffers hold up to n elements, and the recursion stack is only O(log n) deep.", what does "buffer" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a temporary memory area for data
items.explanation: buffer /ˈbʌf.ər/ (danh từ): vùng nhớ đệm. Trong lập trình, buffer là mảng tạm để chứa dữ liệu; nghĩa đời thường: vùng đệm, tấm chắn.
items.explanationEn: buffer /ˈbʌf.ər/ (noun): a temporary memory area for data. In programming, a buffer is temporary storage; in everyday use, a protective cushion.

items.question: Trong câu "(The slice-based version allocates more in total over time, but at any moment the live extra memory is O(n).)", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "(The slice-based version allocates more in total over time, but at any moment the live extra memory is O(n).)", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (động từ): cấp phát (bộ nhớ). "Allocate memory" = cấp phát bộ nhớ; danh từ: allocation. Trái nghĩa: free/release.
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (verb): to reserve memory for use. "Allocate memory" reserves it; noun: allocation. Opposite: free or release.

items.question: Trong câu "Stability: a sort is stable if equal elements keep their original relative order.", từ "relative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stability: a sort is stable if equal elements keep their original relative order.", what does "relative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: relative /ˈrel.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): tương đối (so với nhau). "Relative order" = thứ tự của các phần tử so với nhau; là danh từ thì nghĩa là họ hàng.
items.explanationEn: relative /ˈrel.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): in comparison with each other. "Relative order" is the order of items compared to each other; as a noun, a family member.

items.question: Trong câu "Because merge takes from the left half on ties (<=), merge sort is stable.", từ "tie" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because merge takes from the left half on ties (<=), merge sort is stable.", what does "tie" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a case where two values are equal
items.explanation: tie /taɪ/ (danh từ): trường hợp bằng nhau. "On ties" = khi hai giá trị bằng nhau; "break a tie" = phân định khi hòa.
items.explanationEn: tie /taɪ/ (noun): a case where two values are equal. "On ties" means when values are equal; "break a tie" means deciding between them.

items.question: Trong câu "Data too big for memory: sort chunks that fit, write them to disk, then merge the files sequentially.", từ "chunk" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data too big for memory: sort chunks that fit, write them to disk, then merge the files sequentially.", what does "chunk" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a piece of a larger whole
items.explanation: chunk /tʃʌŋk/ (danh từ): khối, phần dữ liệu. "Split data into chunks" = chia dữ liệu thành từng khối để xử lý dần.
items.explanationEn: chunk /tʃʌŋk/ (noun): a piece of a larger whole. "Split data into chunks" to process it piece by piece.

items.question: Trong câu "Data too big for memory: sort chunks that fit, write them to disk, then merge the files sequentially.", từ "sequentially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data too big for memory: sort chunks that fit, write them to disk, then merge the files sequentially.", what does "sequentially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: sequentially /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl.i/ (trạng từ): tuần tự, lần lượt. Trái nghĩa với randomly (truy cập ngẫu nhiên) và in parallel (song song).
items.explanationEn: sequentially /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl.i/ (adverb): one after another in order. The opposite of randomly and of in parallel.

items.question: Trong câu "Merging by relinking nodes needs no extra array and no random access — the standard O(n log n) list sort.", từ "random access" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merging by relinking nodes needs no extra array and no random access — the standard O(n log n) list sort.", what does "random access" (phrase) mean?
options: truy cập trực tiếp theo vị trí
items.explanation: random access /ˌræn.dəm ˈæk.ses/ (cụm từ): truy cập trực tiếp theo vị trí. Mảng hỗ trợ random access O(1); danh sách liên kết thì không, phải duyệt tuần tự.
items.explanationEn: random access /ˌræn.dəm ˈæk.ses/ (phrase): reaching any position directly. Arrays support O(1) random access; linked lists do not and must be walked in order.

items.question: Trong câu "TimSort (V8, Python, Java objects) is a merge sort that detects sorted runs and uses insertion sort for tiny pieces.", từ "detect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TimSort (V8, Python, Java objects) is a merge sort that detects sorted runs and uses insertion sort for tiny pieces.", what does "detect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: detect /dɪˈtekt/ (động từ): phát hiện, nhận ra. Hay gặp: detect a cycle (phát hiện chu trình), detect changes; danh từ: detection.
items.explanationEn: detect /dɪˈtekt/ (verb): to discover or notice. Common: detect a cycle, detect changes; noun: detection.

items.question: Trong câu "TimSort (V8, Python, Java objects) is a merge sort that detects sorted runs and uses insertion sort for tiny pieces.", từ "tiny" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "TimSort (V8, Python, Java objects) is a merge sort that detects sorted runs and uses insertion sort for tiny pieces.", what does "tiny" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tiny /ˈtaɪ.ni/ (tính từ): rất nhỏ, tí hon. Mạnh hơn small; thuật toán đơn giản thường nhanh hơn trên dữ liệu tiny.
items.explanationEn: tiny /ˈtaɪ.ni/ (adjective): very small. Stronger than small; simple algorithms are often faster on tiny inputs.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose merge sort for linked lists, stability, external sorting or guaranteed bounds; quick sort for fast in-memory array sorting.", từ "guarantee" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose merge sort for linked lists, stability, external sorting or guaranteed bounds; quick sort for fast in-memory array sorting.", what does "guarantee" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (động từ): bảo đảm chắc chắn. "Guaranteed O(n log n)" = chắc chắn không vượt quá O(n log n) với mọi đầu vào.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (verb): to promise for certain. "Guaranteed O(n log n)" means never worse than that on any input.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick sort also relies on 0- and 1-element arrays being sorted, but works differently:", từ "rely on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick sort also relies on 0- and 1-element arrays being sorted, but works differently:", what does "rely on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa vào, phụ thuộc vào. Đồng nghĩa: depend on, rest on; tính từ reliable = đáng tin cậy.
items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. Synonyms: depend on, rest on; the adjective reliable means trustworthy.

items.question: Trong câu "Rearrange the array so everything smaller than the pivot is on its left and everything greater or equal is on its right.", từ "rearrange" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rearrange the array so everything smaller than the pivot is on its left and everything greater or equal is on its right.", what does "rearrange" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change the positions of items
items.explanation: rearrange /ˌriː.əˈreɪndʒ/ (động từ): sắp xếp lại vị trí. Tiền tố re- = làm lại: rearrange, rebuild, relink.
items.explanationEn: rearrange /ˌriː.əˈreɪndʒ/ (verb): to change the positions of items. The prefix re- means again: rearrange, rebuild, relink.

items.question: Trong câu "Pick one element, the pivot.", từ "pivot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pick one element, the pivot.", what does "pivot" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a pin on which something turns
the element used as a dividing point
items.explanation: pivot /ˈpɪv.ət/ (danh từ): phần tử chốt (làm mốc chia). Nghĩa gốc là trục xoay; trong quick sort là phần tử làm mốc để chia mảng.
items.explanationEn: pivot /ˈpɪv.ət/ (noun): the element used as a dividing point. Originally the point something turns on; in quick sort, the element that splits the array.

items.question: Trong câu "Unlike merge sort, quick sort works in place: it only swaps elements inside the original array.", từ "in place" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unlike merge sort, quick sort works in place: it only swaps elements inside the original array.", what does "in place" (phrase) mean?
options: tại chỗ, không cần mảng phụ
optionsEn: within the original array, without extra copies
items.explanation: in place /ɪn ˈpleɪs/ (cụm từ): tại chỗ, không cần mảng phụ. Đừng nhầm với "in place of" = thay cho. "Sort in place" = sắp xếp trực tiếp trên mảng gốc.
items.explanationEn: in place /ɪn ˈpleɪs/ (phrase): within the original array, without extra copies. Do not confuse with "in place of" (instead of). "Sort in place" works on the original array.

items.question: Trong câu "The helper takes the array plus a start and end index, chooses a pivot, partitions the range in place, and returns the pivot's final index.", từ "partition" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The helper takes the array plus a start and end index, chooses a pivot, partitions the range in place, and returns the pivot's final index.", what does "partition" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: partition /pɑːˈtɪʃ.ən/ (động từ): phân chia thành các phần. Cũng là danh từ: partition (vách ngăn, phân vùng ổ đĩa, bước phân hoạch).
items.explanationEn: partition /pɑːˈtɪʃ.ən/ (verb): to divide into separate parts. Also a noun: a dividing wall, a disk partition, or a partitioning step.

items.question: Trong câu "The helper takes the array plus a start and end index, chooses a pivot, partitions the range in place, and returns the pivot's final index.", từ "range" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The helper takes the array plus a start and end index, chooses a pivot, partitions the range in place, and returns the pivot's final index.", what does "range" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: range /reɪndʒ/ (danh từ): đoạn, khoảng (chỉ số). "The range [start, end]" = đoạn chỉ số từ start đến end; "out of range" = ngoài phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: range /reɪndʒ/ (noun): a span between two limits. "The range [start, end]" is the index span; "out of range" means outside it.

items.question: Trong câu "For simplicity the pivot is the first element of the range (consequences in section 10).", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For simplicity the pivot is the first element of the range (consequences in section 10).", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (danh từ): hệ quả, hậu quả. Hay dùng: "as a consequence" = do đó; "consequences of a choice" = hệ quả của lựa chọn.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (noun): a result or effect. Common: "as a consequence" (therefore); "the consequences of a choice".

items.question: Trong câu "swapIdx counts how many values are smaller than the pivot, which is exactly where the pivot belongs.", từ "belong" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "swapIdx counts how many values are smaller than the pivot, which is exactly where the pivot belongs.", what does "belong" (verb) mean?
options: ở đúng vị trí của nó
optionsEn: to be in the right place
items.explanation: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (động từ): ở đúng vị trí của nó. "Where it belongs" = đúng chỗ của nó; "belong to" = thuộc về (sở hữu).
items.explanationEn: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (verb): to be in the right place. "Where it belongs" means its proper place; "belong to" means to be owned by.

items.question: Trong câu "One pass over the range: O(n) time, O(1) extra space.", từ "pass" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One pass over the range: O(n) time, O(1) extra space.", what does "pass" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pass /pɑːs/ (danh từ): lượt duyệt. "In a single pass" = chỉ duyệt qua dữ liệu một lần.
items.explanationEn: pass /pɑːs/ (noun): one complete run through data. "In a single pass" means going through the data only once.

items.question: Trong câu "This scheme (a single left-to-right scan) is a variant of Lomuto partitioning; Hoare partitioning scans from both ends and does fewer swaps.", từ "scheme" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This scheme (a single left-to-right scan) is a variant of Lomuto partitioning; Hoare partitioning scans from both ends and does fewer swaps.", what does "scheme" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scheme /skiːm/ (danh từ): cách thức, phương án. Nghĩa trung tính: phương án, sơ đồ; trong đời thường đôi khi mang nghĩa xấu là mưu đồ.
items.explanationEn: scheme /skiːm/ (noun): a systematic method. Neutrally a method or plan; in everyday British use it can also mean a sly plot.

items.question: Trong câu "This scheme (a single left-to-right scan) is a variant of Lomuto partitioning; Hoare partitioning scans from both ends and does fewer swaps.", từ "variant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This scheme (a single left-to-right scan) is a variant of Lomuto partitioning; Hoare partitioning scans from both ends and does fewer swaps.", what does "variant" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: variant /ˈveə.ri.ənt/ (danh từ): biến thể. "A variant of X" = một phiên bản hơi khác của X.
items.explanationEn: variant /ˈveə.ri.ənt/ (noun): a slightly different version. "A variant of X" is a slightly different form of X.

items.question: Trong câu "This scheme (a single left-to-right scan) is a variant of Lomuto partitioning; Hoare partitioning scans from both ends and does fewer swaps.", từ "scan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This scheme (a single left-to-right scan) is a variant of Lomuto partitioning; Hoare partitioning scans from both ends and does fewer swaps.", what does "scan" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to go through items one by one
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (động từ): duyệt qua lần lượt. "Scan from both ends" = duyệt từ hai đầu vào giữa; cũng dùng là danh từ: a linear scan.
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (verb): to go through items one by one. "Scan from both ends" moves inward from both sides; also a noun: a linear scan.

items.question: Trong câu "The pivot is excluded from both recursive calls — it is already in place.", từ "exclude" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The pivot is excluded from both recursive calls — it is already in place.", what does "exclude" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exclude /ɪkˈskluːd/ (động từ): loại ra, không tính vào. Trái nghĩa: include; "exclusive range" = khoảng không gồm điểm mút.
items.explanationEn: exclude /ɪkˈskluːd/ (verb): to leave out. Opposite: include; an "exclusive range" leaves out its end point.

items.question: Trong câu "The function mutates the input and returns the same array reference.", từ "mutate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The function mutates the input and returns the same array reference.", what does "mutate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (động từ): thay đổi trực tiếp (dữ liệu). Trong JS, push/sort/splice mutate mảng; danh từ: mutation. Nghĩa sinh học: đột biến.
items.explanationEn: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (verb): to change data in place. In JS, push/sort/splice mutate arrays; noun: mutation. In biology it means a genetic change.

items.question: Trong câu "When the pivot lands near the median, each partition halves the range.", từ "land" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the pivot lands near the median, each partition halves the range.", what does "land" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to come down from the air
to end up in a position
items.explanation: land /lænd/ (động từ): rơi vào, nằm ở (vị trí). "Land near/on something" = rốt cuộc nằm ở đâu; nghĩa gốc: hạ cánh.
items.explanationEn: land /lænd/ (verb): to end up in a position. "Land near/on something" means to end up there; the basic sense is an aircraft landing.

items.question: Trong câu "When the pivot lands near the median, each partition halves the range.", từ "median" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the pivot lands near the median, each partition halves the range.", what does "median" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the middle value in sorted order
items.explanation: median /ˈmiː.di.ən/ (danh từ): giá trị trung vị. Median khác mean (trung bình cộng): median là phần tử đứng giữa khi đã sắp xếp.
items.explanationEn: median /ˈmiː.di.ən/ (noun): the middle value in sorted order. Median differs from mean: it is the middle item once the data is sorted.

items.question: Trong câu "The recursion tree has log n levels, and each level does O(n) partition work in total:", từ "in total" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The recursion tree has log n levels, and each level does O(n) partition work in total:", what does "in total" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in total /ɪn ˈtəʊ.təl/ (cụm từ): tổng cộng. Đặt cuối câu để cộng dồn mọi phần: "each level does O(n) work in total".
items.explanationEn: in total /ɪn ˈtəʊ.təl/ (phrase): altogether. Placed at the end to add all parts together: "O(n) work in total".

items.question: Trong câu "With random input the pivot is not perfect but good enough on average: about 1.39 · n log₂ n comparisons, still O(n log n).", từ "on average" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With random input the pivot is not perfect but good enough on average: about 1.39 · n log₂ n comparisons, still O(n log n).", what does "on average" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: typically, taking all cases into account
items.explanation: on average /ɒn ˈæv.ər.ɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): tính trung bình. Hay đi cùng average case (trường hợp trung bình) khi phân tích độ phức tạp.
items.explanationEn: on average /ɒn ˈæv.ər.ɪdʒ/ (phrase): typically, taking all cases into account. Pairs with "average case" in complexity analysis.

items.question: Trong câu "With a first-element pivot, an already-sorted (or reverse-sorted) array is the disaster: the pivot is always the minimum, so each partition peels off just one element.", từ "disaster" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With a first-element pivot, an already-sorted (or reverse-sorted) array is the disaster: the pivot is always the minimum, so each partition peels off just one element.", what does "disaster" (noun) mean?
options: thảm họa, trường hợp tệ hại
items.explanation: disaster /dɪˈzɑː.stər/ (danh từ): thảm họa, trường hợp tệ hại. Dùng ẩn dụ cho kết quả rất tệ; tính từ: disastrous.
items.explanationEn: disaster /dɪˈzɑː.stər/ (noun): a very bad outcome. Used figuratively for a very bad result; adjective: disastrous.

items.question: Trong câu "With a first-element pivot, an already-sorted (or reverse-sorted) array is the disaster: the pivot is always the minimum, so each partition peels off just one element.", từ "peel off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With a first-element pivot, an already-sorted (or reverse-sorted) array is the disaster: the pivot is always the minimum, so each partition peels off just one element.", what does "peel off" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to separate a small part from the rest
items.explanation: peel off /piːl ˈɒf/ (cụm từ): tách ra, bóc ra. Nghĩa gốc: bóc (vỏ, nhãn); ở đây mỗi lần chỉ tách được một phần tử.
items.explanationEn: peel off /piːl ˈɒf/ (phrase): to separate a small part from the rest. Literally to peel a skin or label; here each step removes just one element.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick sort needs no buffer, but the recursion stack is as deep as the tree: O(log n) when balanced, O(n) in the worst case — which in JavaScript can overflow the call stack on a large sorted array.", từ "balanced" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick sort needs no buffer, but the recursion stack is as deep as the tree: O(log n) when balanced, O(n) in the worst case — which in JavaScript can overflow the call stack on a large sorted array.", what does "balanced" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: with parts of roughly equal size
items.explanation: balanced /ˈbæl.ənst/ (tính từ): cân bằng. "A balanced tree" = cây cân bằng, hai nhánh có độ sâu gần bằng nhau.
items.explanationEn: balanced /ˈbæl.ənst/ (adjective): with parts of roughly equal size. "A balanced tree" has branches of nearly equal depth.

items.question: Trong câu "The ideal pivot is the median, but finding it exactly costs time.", từ "ideal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The ideal pivot is the median, but finding it exactly costs time.", what does "ideal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ideal /aɪˈdɪəl/ (tính từ): lý tưởng, tốt nhất. "Ideal but impractical" = lý tưởng nhưng khó áp dụng thực tế.
items.explanationEn: ideal /aɪˈdɪəl/ (adjective): the best possible. "Ideal but impractical" means best in theory, hard in practice.

items.question: Trong câu "Expected O(n log n) on every input; O(n²) still possible but astronomically unlikely", từ "astronomically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Expected O(n log n) on every input; O(n²) still possible but astronomically unlikely", what does "astronomically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: astronomically /ˌæs.trəˈnɒm.ɪ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): cực kỳ, vô cùng (mức độ). Nghĩa gốc liên quan thiên văn; dùng bóng để nhấn mạnh: astronomically high/unlikely.
items.explanationEn: astronomically /ˌæs.trəˈnɒm.ɪ.kəl.i/ (adverb): to an extremely large degree. Literally about astronomy; figuratively an intensifier: astronomically high or unlikely.

items.question: Trong câu "Expected O(n log n) on every input; O(n²) still possible but astronomically unlikely", từ "unlikely" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Expected O(n log n) on every input; O(n²) still possible but astronomically unlikely", what does "unlikely" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unlikely /ʌnˈlaɪ.kli/ (tính từ): khó xảy ra. Trái nghĩa: likely; "highly unlikely" = rất khó xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: unlikely /ʌnˈlaɪ.kli/ (adjective): not probable. Opposite: likely; "highly unlikely" means very improbable.

items.question: Trong câu "More refinements used in real libraries:", từ "refinement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More refinements used in real libraries:", what does "refinement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): cải tiến nhỏ, tinh chỉnh. Động từ refine = tinh chỉnh, làm cho tốt hơn.
items.explanationEn: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (noun): a small improvement. The verb refine means to improve something in small ways.

items.question: Trong câu "A three-way partition (less / equal / greater) groups all copies of the pivot and never recurses into them.", từ "group" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A three-way partition (less / equal / greater) groups all copies of the pivot and never recurses into them.", what does "group" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: group /ɡruːp/ (động từ): gom lại thành nhóm. Dùng như động từ: "group items by key" = gom phần tử theo khóa.
items.explanationEn: group /ɡruːp/ (verb): to put together. As a verb: "group items by key".

items.question: Trong câu "Recurse into the smaller side and loop on the larger one; the stack stays O(log n) even in the worst case.", từ "recurse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recurse into the smaller side and loop on the larger one; the stack stays O(log n) even in the worst case.", what does "recurse" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to call the same function again
items.explanation: recurse /rɪˈkɜːs/ (động từ): gọi đệ quy. "Recurse into X" = gọi đệ quy trên phần X; danh từ: recursion.
items.explanationEn: recurse /rɪˈkɜːs/ (verb): to call the same function again. "Recurse into X" means making a recursive call on X; noun: recursion.

items.question: Trong câu "Switch to insertion sort below ~10–20 elements.", từ "switch to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Switch to insertion sort below ~10–20 elements.", what does "switch to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: switch to /swɪtʃ tuː/ (cụm từ): chuyển sang dùng. "Switch from A to B" = chuyển từ A sang B.
items.explanationEn: switch to /swɪtʃ tuː/ (phrase): to change over to. "Switch from A to B" means changing over from A to B.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick sort is usually faster on arrays because it scans memory sequentially (cache-friendly), swaps in place, and has a small constant factor.", từ "constant factor" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick sort is usually faster on arrays because it scans memory sequentially (cache-friendly), swaps in place, and has a small constant factor.", what does "constant factor" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the fixed multiplier hidden by Big O
items.explanation: constant factor /ˌkɒn.stənt ˈfæk.tər/ (cụm từ): hệ số hằng. Big O bỏ qua constant factor, nhưng thực tế nó quyết định thuật toán nào nhanh hơn.
items.explanationEn: constant factor /ˌkɒn.stənt ˈfæk.tər/ (phrase): the fixed multiplier hidden by Big O. Big O ignores constant factors, yet in practice they decide which algorithm runs faster.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick sort is usually faster on arrays because it scans memory sequentially (cache-friendly), swaps in place, and has a small constant factor.", từ "sequentially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick sort is usually faster on arrays because it scans memory sequentially (cache-friendly), swaps in place, and has a small constant factor.", what does "sequentially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: sequentially /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl.i/ (trạng từ): tuần tự, liên tiếp. Đọc bộ nhớ tuần tự giúp tận dụng cache của CPU.
items.explanationEn: sequentially /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl.i/ (adverb): in order, one after another. Reading memory sequentially makes good use of the CPU cache.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick sort is usually faster on arrays because it scans memory sequentially (cache-friendly), swaps in place, and has a small constant factor.", từ "cache-friendly" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick sort is usually faster on arrays because it scans memory sequentially (cache-friendly), swaps in place, and has a small constant factor.", what does "cache-friendly" (adjective) mean?
options: tận dụng tốt bộ nhớ đệm
optionsEn: making good use of the CPU cache
items.explanation: cache-friendly /ˈkæʃ ˌfrend.li/ (tính từ): tận dụng tốt bộ nhớ đệm. Hậu tố -friendly = thân thiện với: user-friendly, mobile-friendly.
items.explanationEn: cache-friendly /ˈkæʃ ˌfrend.li/ (adjective): making good use of the CPU cache. The suffix -friendly means suited to: user-friendly, mobile-friendly.

items.question: Trong câu "Sorting [3, 5a, 5b, 1] with the pivot helper above: the swap that moves 1 forward throws 5a behind 5b, and the result is [1, 3, 5b, 5a].", từ "forward" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sorting [3, 5a, 5b, 1] with the pivot helper above: the swap that moves 1 forward throws 5a behind 5b, and the result is [1, 3, 5b, 5a].", what does "forward" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: forward /ˈfɔː.wəd/ (trạng từ): lên phía trước. "Move forward" = tiến lên trước; động từ "forward" còn nghĩa là chuyển tiếp (email).
items.explanationEn: forward /ˈfɔː.wəd/ (adverb): toward the front. "Move forward" means toward the front; as a verb, forward also means to pass on an email.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice, V8's Array.prototype.sort uses TimSort and has been stable since ES2019; Java sorts primitives with dual-pivot quick sort and objects with TimSort.", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice, V8's Array.prototype.sort uses TimSort and has been stable since ES2019; Java sorts primitives with dual-pivot quick sort and objects with TimSort.", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræk.tɪs/ (cụm từ): trên thực tế. Thường đối lập với "in theory": in theory X, but in practice Y.
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræk.tɪs/ (phrase): in real use. Often contrasted with "in theory": in theory X, but in practice Y.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice, V8's Array.prototype.sort uses TimSort and has been stable since ES2019; Java sorts primitives with dual-pivot quick sort and objects with TimSort.", từ "primitive" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice, V8's Array.prototype.sort uses TimSort and has been stable since ES2019; Java sorts primitives with dual-pivot quick sort and objects with TimSort.", what does "primitive" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: primitive /ˈprɪm.ɪ.tɪv/ (danh từ): kiểu dữ liệu nguyên thủy. Ví dụ primitive: int, double, boolean; khác với object (đối tượng).
items.explanationEn: primitive /ˈprɪm.ɪ.tɪv/ (noun): a basic built-in data type. Examples of primitives: int, double, boolean; unlike objects.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice, V8's Array.prototype.sort uses TimSort and has been stable since ES2019; Java sorts primitives with dual-pivot quick sort and objects with TimSort.", từ "dual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice, V8's Array.prototype.sort uses TimSort and has been stable since ES2019; Java sorts primitives with dual-pivot quick sort and objects with TimSort.", what does "dual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dual /ˈdjuː.əl/ (tính từ): kép, gồm hai. Hay gặp: dual-core (lõi kép), dual-pivot (hai phần tử chốt).
items.explanationEn: dual /ˈdjuː.əl/ (adjective): having two parts. Common: dual-core, dual-pivot.

items.question: Trong câu "Both are comparison sorts, and no comparison sort beats O(n log n) in general — radix sort, next, sidesteps that limit.", từ "in general" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are comparison sorts, and no comparison sort beats O(n log n) in general — radix sort, next, sidesteps that limit.", what does "in general" (phrase) mean?
options: nói chung, trong mọi trường hợp
items.explanation: in general /ɪn ˈdʒen.ər.əl/ (cụm từ): nói chung, trong mọi trường hợp. Đối lập với "in particular" (nói riêng, cụ thể).
items.explanationEn: in general /ɪn ˈdʒen.ər.əl/ (phrase): in all normal cases. Contrasts with "in particular".

items.question: Trong câu "Both are comparison sorts, and no comparison sort beats O(n log n) in general — radix sort, next, sidesteps that limit.", từ "sidestep" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are comparison sorts, and no comparison sort beats O(n log n) in general — radix sort, next, sidesteps that limit.", what does "sidestep" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sidestep /ˈsaɪd.step/ (động từ): né tránh, đi vòng qua. Nghĩa đen: bước sang ngang; nghĩa bóng: tránh né một vấn đề hay giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: sidestep /ˈsaɪd.step/ (verb): to avoid by going around. Literally stepping to the side; figuratively avoiding a problem or limit.

items.question: Trong câu "Both are comparison sorts, and no comparison sort beats O(n log n) in general — radix sort, next, sidesteps that limit.", từ "limit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are comparison sorts, and no comparison sort beats O(n log n) in general — radix sort, next, sidesteps that limit.", what does "limit" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a boundary that cannot be passed
items.explanation: limit /ˈlɪm.ɪt/ (danh từ): giới hạn. "Lower limit / upper limit" = cận dưới / cận trên.
items.explanationEn: limit /ˈlɪm.ɪt/ (noun): a boundary that cannot be passed. "Lower limit / upper limit" are the minimum and maximum bounds.

items.question: Trong câu "O(n²) sorts do not scale; merge sort and quick sort bring sorting down to O(n log n) using divide and conquer.", từ "scale" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "O(n²) sorts do not scale; merge sort and quick sort bring sorting down to O(n log n) using divide and conquer.", what does "scale" (verb) mean?
options: mở rộng tốt khi dữ liệu tăng
optionsEn: to keep working well as size grows
items.explanation: scale /skeɪl/ (động từ): mở rộng tốt khi dữ liệu tăng. "Does not scale" = không chịu nổi khi dữ liệu lớn; danh từ: scalability.
items.explanationEn: scale /skeɪl/ (verb): to keep working well as size grows. "Does not scale" means it breaks down on large inputs; noun: scalability.

items.question: Trong câu "merge of two sorted arrays is a two-pointer O(n + m) routine — do not forget to copy the leftovers.", từ "leftover" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "merge of two sorted arrays is a two-pointer O(n + m) routine — do not forget to copy the leftovers.", what does "leftover" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: leftover /ˈleftˌəʊ.vər/ (danh từ): phần còn sót lại. Thường ở số nhiều "leftovers"; đời thường chỉ đồ ăn thừa.
items.explanationEn: leftover /ˈleftˌəʊ.vər/ (noun): the remaining items. Usually plural; in everyday use it means food left after a meal.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose merge sort for linked lists, stability, external sorting or guaranteed bounds; quick sort for fast in-memory array sorting.", từ "bound" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose merge sort for linked lists, stability, external sorting or guaranteed bounds; quick sort for fast in-memory array sorting.", what does "bound" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bound /baʊnd/ (danh từ): cận, giới hạn (trên/dưới). "Upper bound" = cận trên; Big O cho một upper bound về thời gian chạy.
items.explanationEn: bound /baʊnd/ (noun): a limit on a value. "Upper bound" is a maximum; Big O gives an upper bound on running time.

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript's built-in sort is TimSort (a merge sort hybrid) and is stable.", từ "hybrid" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript's built-in sort is TimSort (a merge sort hybrid) and is stable.", what does "hybrid" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hybrid /ˈhaɪ.brɪd/ (danh từ): sự kết hợp, lai ghép. "A hybrid of A and B" = kết hợp A và B; ví dụ hybrid cloud, hybrid app.
items.explanationEn: hybrid /ˈhaɪ.brɪd/ (noun): a mix of two approaches. "A hybrid of A and B" combines both; e.g. hybrid cloud, hybrid app.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick sort places a pivot at its final index, then sorts each side in place; its speed depends on the pivot splitting the range evenly.", từ "evenly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick sort places a pivot at its final index, then sorts each side in place; its speed depends on the pivot splitting the range evenly.", what does "evenly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: evenly /ˈiː.vən.li/ (trạng từ): đều nhau. "Split evenly" = chia đều; tính từ even còn có nghĩa khác là chẵn.
items.explanationEn: evenly /ˈiː.vən.li/ (adverb): into equal parts. "Split evenly" means into equal parts; the adjective even can also mean divisible by two.

items.question: Trong câu "Bad pivots on sorted or duplicate-heavy data cause O(n²) time and O(n) stack; random pivots, three-way partitioning and smaller-side recursion prevent it.", từ "prevent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bad pivots on sorted or duplicate-heavy data cause O(n²) time and O(n) stack; random pivots, three-way partitioning and smaller-side recursion prevent it.", what does "prevent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prevent /prɪˈvent/ (động từ): ngăn chặn. "Prevent X from happening" = ngăn X xảy ra; danh từ: prevention.
items.explanationEn: prevent /prɪˈvent/ (verb): to stop from happening. "Prevent X from happening"; noun: prevention.
